'''0.26g''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that added a brief tutorial and changed the [[PP-2000]] to be a primary weapon.

==Changelog==
* Added tutorial which offers rewards when completed
* Fixed a visual bug in the displaying of decals
* Fixed a bug allowing the player to take [[PP-2000]] as one-handed weapon
* Optimization of the game interface giving boost to performance in battle
